CustomField.description: Specifies the calendar day of the month on which payments are due when a fixed day-of-month rule applies.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a number between 1 and 31. Required only when Payment Date Rule is set to “Specific Day of Month”. If the selected day does not exist in a month, standard business-day adjustment rules should apply.
CustomField.label: Payment Date of the Month
